body:
Design doc for a shared humanness.h/.c layer (timing jitter, Gaussian aim noise, overshoot movement, mood state) that story_ai.c and character-tick call into, directly modeled on MISHRI's own real HumannessLayer.ts implementation. NORTHSTAR only. Commit SHANKPIT a7332d8.

⚓ ☃
title: HUMANNESS_NORTHSTAR.md: realistic scriptable NPCs (grounded in MISHRI)
